About Coforge

Coforge is a global digital services and solutions provider, specializing in digital transformation, cloud, data, and AI-driven solutions
The company focuses on key industries such as Banking & Financial Services, Insurance, Travel, Transportation & Hospitality
Coforge is known for its engineering-led approach, strong client partnerships, and emphasis on emerging technologies like AI, automation, and cloud modernization
With a global delivery model and innovation-driven culture, Coforge provides opportunities to work on cutting-edge AI/ML and enterprise-scale digital transformation projects

Agentic AI Engineer / Data Scientist

35 Years Experience • Full-Time

Key Responsibilities

Design and ship autonomous AI agents with real-world tool use, memory, and multi-step reasoning
Build and optimize RAG pipelines from chunking strategies and hybrid search to re-ranking and contextual retrieval
Own end-to-end ML pipelines from data ingestion through to model serving at scale
Deploy and manage models on AWS Bedrock and AgentCore runtime
Engineer prompts and context strategies that push model performance to its limits
Instrument MLOps practices — CI/CD, orchestration, monitoring, and model governance — so what you build stays reliable in production

What will help you to be successful in this role

Required

3–5 years of hands-on experience building production ML or AI systems
Strong Python skills and fluency with ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn)
Deep experience with LLM APIs, embeddings, and vector databases
Solid grasp of RAG architectures — chunking, hybrid search, re-ranking, contextual retrieval
Hands-on experience building agents with at least one framework: Strands, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, or Azure AI Agent Service
Clear understanding of agentic primitives: workflows, tools, short-term and long-term memory
Strong prompt engineering and context engineering skills
Experience deploying on AWS Bedrock and AgentCore runtime
